Duties of the office include:


Secretary to the Board of Supervisors, including preparing their agenda; request to be added to the agenda.
Commissioner of all elections for school board, city, county, state and federal elections
Real estate transfers and overseer of county plats
Provide passport services
Audit & pays all claims against the county
Keeps a complete record of all accounting transactions of the county
Payroll and human resource department
Certifies  the Schools, Cities, Townships, Agricultural Extension, Emergency    Management Agency, E911 Service Board, and Assessor completed budgets to the Department of Management
Compiles levies for taxation and prepares tax statements
For additional information about our office, please visit the auditor’s web site at www.iowaauditors.org.  Our office is always available to help with your questions and invites you to visit our office anytime.
